nextgen_office_section.full_text: NextGen® Office NextGen Office provides EHI exports for patients as a ZIP archive containing various files. ZIP files can be opened and extracted using a variety of free products (WinZip, 7-Zip, etc.). Files will be either: CCDA Format – An XML file following the CCDA specification here https://www.hl7.org/implement/standards/ . CSV – Comma-Separated Variable - A file of text data with each field delimited by a comma. Each record includes one or more fields. Binary files – Files of binary type, such as images and PDFs.
